# Read-Only MCP Server

This feature provides a read-only server over a compiled knowledge base, allowing users to query engineering knowledge without the ability to modify it. It enables workflows such as test planning, understanding component functionality, and exploring the compiled knowledge.

- `knowledge_compiler/mcp/server.py` — `knowledge_compiler.mcp.server.serve`
